request.description:
Creates a new training class.

Request body fields:
- className: String (required)
- capacity: Integer (required, must be > 0)
- trainingTypeId: Long (required)
- regionId: Long (required)
- districtId: Long (required)
- cityId: Long (required)
- universityId: Long (required)
- trainerTotId: Long (required)
- statusId: Long (required)
- location: String (required)
- description: String (optional)
- preRequests: String (optional)
- createdBy: String (optional)
- updatedBy: String (optional)

Returns HTTP 201 on success.

request.description:
Updates an existing training class identified by its class code.

Path variable:
- classCode: String (e.g. TC-001)

Request body fields (same as create — all required fields must be provided):
- className: String (required)
- capacity: Integer (required, must be > 0)
- trainingTypeId: Long (required)
- regionId: Long (required)
- districtId: Long (required)
- cityId: Long (required)
- universityId: Long (required)
- trainerTotId: Long (required)
- statusId: Long (required)
- location: String (required)
- description: String (optional)
- preRequests: String (optional)
- createdBy: String (optional)
- updatedBy: String (optional)

Returns HTTP 200 on success.

Fetches a single training class by its class code.

Path variable:
- classCode: String (e.g. TC-001)

Response data shape:
{
  "id": Long,
  "classCode": String,
  "className": String,
  "capacity": Integer,
  "location": String,
  "description": String,
  "preRequests": String,
  "trainingType": { "id": Long, "value": String },
  "region": { "id": Long, "value": String },
  "district": { "id": Long, "value": String },
  "city": { "id": Long, "value": String },
  "university": { "id": Long, "value": String },
  "trainerTot": { "id": Long, "value": String },
  "status": { "id": Long, "value": String },
  "isActive": Boolean,
  "createdBy": String,
  "createdAt": LocalDateTime,
  "updatedBy": String,
  "updatedAt": LocalDateTime
}

Returns HTTP 200 on success.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of training classes with optional filters.

Query params:
- page: int (default 0)
- size: int (default 10)

Request body (all fields optional — send {} or omit body to get all records):
- classCode: String
- className: String
- location: String
- trainingTypeId: Long
- statusId: Long
- regionId: Long
- districtId: Long
- cityId: Long
- universityId: Long
- trainerTotId: Long

Returns HTTP 200 on success.

Activates or deactivates a training class by its class code.

Path variable:
- classCode: String (e.g. TC-001)

Query param:
- isActive: Boolean (required) — true to activate, false to deactivate

Returns HTTP 200 on success.
